title: Michelle Investigations
gallery_text:
What happens behind the scenes of a project? Windows, proposals, experiments, and iterations reveal the process behind Ec(h)oes in the Rings, one of the winning projects of the 5th edition of Bolzano Art Week.

The work transforms the Ginkgo biloba, a landmark of the city, into the artwork itself, uncovering its hidden patterns and translating its unique features into new forms and material expressions.

answers.interest: I am interested in this class because I would like data and its visual representation to become tools for my research. I believe that the possibility of using data to generate simulations could enrich and expand my future practice.
answers.suggestions: I am not yet familiar enough with this field to have specific references in mind, so I would be interested in discovering different tools, approaches, and examples through the class.
